description: This file defines a Catalyst plugin role for generating static resource URIs, supporting CDN integration via configuration.

classes.name: Coocook::Plugin::UriForStatic
classes.description: A Moose role providing a method to generate static resource URIs, supporting CDN base URI configuration.

methods.name: uri_for_static
methods.description: Generates a URI for static resources, either relative to a configured CDN base URI or within the local static directory.
